name: Image with Text
summary: Named passive media-and-narrative section with required target-owned content, five container-responsive presentations, and an optional Button-composed action.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Thematic section named by its required visible title and omitted when media, title, or body is incomplete.

anatomy.name: media
anatomy.description: Required target-owned native media region with explicit informative or decorative semantics.

anatomy.name: content
anatomy.description: Required narrative grouping that owns section placement and measure without becoming a landmark.

anatomy.name: eyebrow
anatomy.description: Optional short contextual label that never replaces the required title.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Non-empty visible contextual heading whose id names the thematic section.

anatomy.name: body
anatomy.description: Required non-empty target-owned narrative rich content.

anatomy.name: cta
anatomy.description: Optional complete Button-composed link or command whose semantics and lifecycle remain target-owned.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Media-first composition that stacks in narrow component containers and becomes a balanced split when space permits.

variants.name: reversed
variants.description: Preserves media-first DOM order while placing content first visually only in sufficiently wide split mode.

variants.name: stacked
variants.description: Single-column presentation at every component-container width with bounded media.

variants.name: overlay
variants.description: Content overlays bounded media with an invariant scrim and explicit inverse semantic foregrounds.

variants.name: offset
variants.description: Contained split-or-stack presentation with canonical section inset, grid gap, and rounded media.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Single intrinsic size whose crop, measure, threshold, padding curve, overlay block size, and scrim geometry remain private composition.

states.name: default
states.description: Complete passive section with required media, visible title, and non-empty body; layout modifiers are variants rather than states.

behavior.name: namedSection
behavior.description: The required visible contextual heading names the thematic section without adding a widget role or an unnecessary nested landmark.

behavior.name: requiredComposition
behavior.description: Media, non-empty title, and non-empty body are a coupled required composition; targets omit the section rather than emit incomplete or unnamed markup.

behavior.name: mediaSemantics
behavior.description: Targets own native source, intrinsic dimensions, responsive sources, loading, focal point, and the informative alternative or decorative empty alternative.

behavior.name: actionComposition
behavior.description: A complete optional action composes Button and preserves target/Button-owned activation, focus, disabled, busy, result, destination, and analytics behavior.

behavior.name: meaningfulSourceOrder
behavior.description: Adapters preserve media then narrative in DOM/source order; Reversed changes only wide visual placement and returns to media-first when stacked.

behavior.name: responsiveComposition
behavior.description: CSS responds to the named component container with logical geometry; no viewport breakpoint, site-only implementation, layout read, observer, or neutral controller is required.

behavior.name: targetOwnership
behavior.description: Targets own image selection and art direction, heading rank, rich-text sanitization, action routing/result, analytics, loading, editor preview, and content completeness.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Default, visually Reversed, always Stacked, Overlay, or contained Offset presentation; responsive geometry remains private.

properties.name: media
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the entire section when target-owned native media is unavailable.
properties.description: Required target-owned native media with explicit alternative, intrinsic dimensions, responsive sources, loading, and focal-point policy.

properties.name: eyebrow
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the eyebrow without leaving empty rhythm.
properties.description: Optional short context above the required heading; it never names the section by itself.

properties.name: title
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the entire section when the trimmed visible heading is empty.
properties.description: Required non-empty visible contextual heading; targets choose the appropriate native heading rank.

properties.name: body
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the entire section when narrative rich content is empty.
properties.description: Required non-empty target-owned narrative rich content; targets own sanitization and native markup.

properties.name: action
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the action unless the target can supply a complete valid Button composition.
properties.description: Optional complete Button-composed navigation or command; target owns destination/result, analytics, disabled, and busy lifecycle.

accessibility: Require non-empty media, title, and body; associate the thematic section with the visible contextual heading through aria-labelledby.
Give informative media a useful alternative and intrinsic dimensions; use an empty alt for decorative imagery without duplicating adjacent narrative.
Preserve media then narrative in DOM/source order for every variant; Reversed changes only wide visual placement.
Ensure Overlay applies an invariant scrim, explicit inverse child colors, and a readable forced-colors fallback for every supplied media frame.
Render the optional action only as a complete canonical Button composition with truthful native navigation or command semantics and visible focus.
Add no section focus model, Arrow-key behavior, live region, autoplay, timeout, authored motion, or neutral runtime.
Omit incomplete content and leave heading rank, rich-text sanitization, media loading/art direction, action results, analytics, and update announcements with the owning target.

web.notes: Implemented by a named native section, required target media/title/body, optional Button composition, five container-responsive CSS presentations, and no neutral runtime.

shopify.notes: Merchant-editable section maps responsive image data, decorative classification, required heading/rich text, optional eyebrow/complete button pair, and five presentation choices.
